goal: Establish a source-controlled Initial Project for Nai Chang Moo before application source scaffolding.
constraints: Use engineering-tool workflows, not a generic AI dashboard.
Pilot deploys on Vercel; production targets Hostinger VPS + PostgreSQL + Cloudflare R2.
Hermes pilot only reviews AI Takeoff evidence via typed jobs and approval gates.
Do not migrate or modify Land Acquisition V2 legacy source/schema/data in this repository.

Create versioned roadmap and commit policy
Define architecture ADRs and PostgreSQL schema
Scaffold Next.js application and Drizzle migrations

Implement SVG icon system and enterprise quotation intake
Draft Hermes typed job boundary and security controls
Run security audit, tag milestone and write handoff
